scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.deploy: npm run build && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo "Uncommitted changes detected. Commit or stash first."; exit 1; } && git switch gh-pages || git switch -c gh-pages && rm -rf * && cp -r ./dist/* . && git add -A && git commit -m "deploy: $(date +%Y-%m-%d\ %H:%M)" && git push -u origin gh-pages && git switch main
